summary: The diff implements most of the requested requirements well. REQ-6, REQ-7, REQ-8, and REQ-9 are substantially implemented. The LNT branding is applied throughout, the admin panel exists with add/delete functionality gated behind Internet Identity, polling is set at 10 seconds, and navigation is present. A hallucinated ProfileSetupModal with user profile management was introduced but not requested. An updateMusicEntry backend method was also added without being requested.

hallucinated_features.description: ProfileSetupModal component that prompts first-time authenticated users to enter their name and saves a user profile to the backend
hallucinated_features.reason: No requirement asked for user profile creation or a profile setup modal. The build request only requested Internet Identity authentication for owner access gating.

hallucinated_features.description: updateMusicEntry backend method allowing admins to update existing music entries
hallucinated_features.reason: The requirements only specify adding and deleting music entries in the admin panel. No update/edit functionality was requested.

hallucinated_features.description: User profile storage and retrieval (getCallerUserProfile, getUserProfile, saveCallerUserProfile) in the backend
hallucinated_features.reason: The build request does not mention user profiles or any profile management system. Only Internet Identity authentication for owner gating was requested.

hallucinated_features.description: URL parameter utilities for session persistence and admin token extraction (urlParams.ts with caffeineAdminToken handling)
hallucinated_features.reason: No requirement asked for URL-based admin token passing or session parameter persistence utilities. Authentication should use Internet Identity only.
